title: Databel Churn Review
description: A 4-page executive report on telecom customer churn: headline KPIs, root causes and retention recommendations. Found month-to-month customers churned 17× more than two-year customers, with the third support call as the tipping point.

title: This portfolio website
description: A fast, accessible portfolio in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. All content is managed from a Google Sheet, backed up to GitHub daily by a GitHub Action.

title: Insurance KPI dashboard
description: An anonymised version of my premium collection, renewal and branch-performance reporting.

title: SQL case study
description: A query-driven analysis that starts from a clear business question and ends with an answer.

title: Road Accident Dashboard
description: Interactive dashboard of road accident data: total casualties and accidents with year-over-year change, breakdowns by severity, vehicle type, road surface and light conditions, and a map of accident locations.

title: Global CO2 Emissions
description: Explores CO2 emissions by country: a world emissions map, emissions versus population, and each country's share of global emissions over time.

title: Sugar Wagon Geospatial Analysis
description: Customer distribution analytics for a sugar manufacturer: maps customers within a chosen distance of each factory, with a sales-versus-goal KPI and a customer detail table to support delivery planning.

title: Maven Supplies Executive Dashboard
description: Executive retail sales view with YTD sales, profit and discount KPIs, sales versus goal by region, sales and profit by city and category, and trends over time, filterable by date, region and segment.

title: UFO Sightings in the USA
description: Analyses reported UFO sightings across US states from 1990 to 2014: a state-level map, the most commonly reported shapes, and how sightings changed year by year.

title: King County Real Estate
description: Real estate dashboard for King County, Washington: median price, homes sold and typical build year, a zip-code price map, and the weekly median price trend.
